EmailTemplate.subject: Get a glimpse inside the latest trends in global payments
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We're thrilled to unveil the latest trends in global payments in a beautiful and interactive new report recently released. ‌
Throughout our ten year journey, we’ve seen big changes in how our clients get paid, and how their customers pay; we’ve also had a firsthand look at some of the modern demands of consumers in their payment experiences. ‌
